from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689839/attempts/999ba5f7203e4d1c9459d496b4c7cec5/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=base/'task-2e4d3f07.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    # The repeated non-background marker cells define horizontal gaps to fill.\n    from collections import Counter\n    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]\n    background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        marker_counts = Counter(v for v in row if v != background)\n        for marker, count in marker_counts.items():\n            if count >= 2:\n                cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]\n                for c in range(min(cols) + 1, max(cols)):\n                    if out[r][c] == background:\n                        out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
p.write_text(source)
# Demo pair
inp=[[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7],[4,7,4,7],[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[4,7,4,7],[4,7,4,7],[4,7,4,7],[4,7,4,7],[4,7,4,7],[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7],[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[4,7,4,7],[7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7],[7,7,7,7]]
